sections.what_happened: Four Palestinians were reportedly killed by Israeli strikes across Gaza on Monday Nov 2: 2 killed and 6 wounded in two Khan Younis airstrikes (a woman and two children among the wounded), a third killed at Al-Mussadar (Reuters morning wire, already in 1400-01), plus a fourth killed and five injured in a strike on a car in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighbourhood (Hamas-affiliated Palestinian media). The IDF gave no immediate comment on Monday's strikes. Separately, the IDF announced Nov 2 that recent strikes killed 6 Hamas operatives, including 2 who took part in the October 7, 2023 onslaught: Mohammed Kamel Maslih Qdeih (Khan Younis, Saturday; Nir Oz raider, Nukhba operational-readiness role) and Diaa Abdel Mohsen Mohammed Abu al-Rous (Nuseirat, Saturday; Nukhba), Nabil Hamad (recruitment apparatus) and Mohannad Nader Mahmoud Dahdouh (sniper commander) in northern Gaza Saturday, and Wael Naif Fahmi Muslim (Nukhba, Oct 7 invader) and Arafat Kamal Muhammad Ar'air (rocket squad commander) on October 22. The IDF said all six had recently been advancing attacks and restoring Hamas capabilities, 'in systematic violation of the ceasefire'. The 1,580-since-ceasefire toll (Gaza health officials via Reuters) is unchanged by this update.
sections.what_verified: Reuters (T1) for 3 Monday deaths + 1,580 toll; Times of Israel (T3) for the IDF announcement and the 4th death report; IDF (T1, STATE IL) as primary source for the 6 operatives claim
sections.what_disputed: IDF gave no immediate comment on Monday's strikes, so the Monday deaths are medic/media-sourced only; Hamas denies rebuilding its arsenal and accuses Israel of undermining the peace deal (standing counterpoint, 1400-01). The Tel al-Hawa 4th death comes from Hamas-affiliated media, not medics or the IDF.
sections.why_matters: Monday's Gaza toll is now 4 -- and the IDF just named the 6 operatives it says it killed for rebuilding Hamas, two of them from October 7. The ceasefire's body count keeps rising on both ledgers.

totw_analysis: Our read: Monday's Gaza toll is now 4 -- and the IDF just named the 6 operatives it says it killed for rebuilding Hamas, two of them from October 7. The ceasefire's body count keeps rising on both ledgers. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Ceasefire enforcement or ceasefire collapse? Israel says it is killing operatives rebuilding Hamas in violation of the truce; Gaza medics count a rising civilian toll under a ceasefire that was supposed to stop the killing.
